provider: HKU Business School BBA(Acc&Fin) and BBA(ADA) Syllabuses 2025-26
note: The official 2025-26 syllabuses apply to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. BBA(Acc&Fin) requires a 108-credit Professional Core in Accounting and a 36-credit Minor in Finance. Because the 24 Faculty Core credits overlap, the syllabus requires 24 credits from its dated Finance disciplinary elective appendix in lieu of those four courses; the remaining Minor core courses are ECON1220 and FINA2320. BBA(ADA) requires 144 credits of Faculty and Disciplinary Core courses plus 12 credits from its dated disciplinary elective pool. Language, Common Core, AI literacy, non-credit University requirements and free electives are excluded because they contain open or placeholder course ranges. Courses are not necessarily offered every year.

supplements.programmeName: Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting and Finance / Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting Data Analytics (Major in Professional Core in Accounting)
supplements.ruleSummary: 144 programme credits: 108-credit Professional Core in Accounting and 36-credit Minor in Finance. The Accounting Core includes one 6-credit statistics option and the ACCT3112 capstone. The Finance Minor comprises ECON1220, FINA2320 and 24 credits from the dated Finance disciplinary elective list in lieu of the four overlapped Faculty Core courses.
supplements.evidenceGap: The official syllabus is subject to approval and says courses are not necessarily offered every year. The replacement-elective rule and statistics choice remain manual checks. Language, Common Core, AI literacy, non-credit University requirements and free electives are open or partly placeholder-coded and are excluded.
